name: SNO+ Collaboration
notes: The official homepage mentions the University of Oxford and UC Berkeley as affiliated institutions but does not provide a full institution list or a count; no membership counts were recorded rather than guessed from a partial mention.

summary.plain: The international team of scientists who run the SNO+ experiment in Sudbury, Canada, searching for a rare nuclear decay and studying solar and reactor neutrinos.
summary.technical: Collaboration operating SNO+ at SNOLAB; membership counts not found in the sources consulted (only Oxford and UC Berkeley are named on the homepage, without a full list).
